messages.text: Hey Jess! I’m interested in the room you have available in Spring Hill!

Hi Melissa Reyes, thanks for reaching out! We'd love to learn a bit more about you before we go any further. Could you tell me: when are you looking to move in, and a little about yourself (work or study, lifestyle)? Thanks!
Hi Melissa Reyes 😊 Thanks for reaching out. Can you please tell me a bit about yourself? Include your cultural background, hobbies, age, and work or academic life if any. Thanks!

Hi Jess, thanks for getting back to me! I’m 24 years old and originally from the United States and just moved to Brisbane! I am currently still in school finishing my masters degree in Cybersecurity but I graduate in May and do school online as my uni is back in the states: I am currently looking for a job as I just arrived but definitely expecting to be working full time soon. I live a pretty active life style as I love to go out for morning and night walks/runs and frequent the gym as well. I am a very organized and respectful person and can be social but definitely value my alone time as well. I’m looking to move in any day after March 7th ideally the sooner the better.
Hi Melissa, quick correction — tonight it will be Mathis showing you around, not Dee. His WhatsApp: +61411590261. See you tonight!
Just to confirm — tonight’s inspection is at 6:50pm at 40 Rosa St, Spring Hill QLD 4000. See you there! 😊

Hey Melissa! The room is still available 😊 We're doing a showing tonight at 6:30pm — 40 Rosa St, Spring Hill. If you'd like to come check it out, just reply to confirm! Our host will be there to show you around. See you tonight? 🏠
